subject: English
stimulus: (a) I could not cope but my friend is accustomed to ——. (b) Had I been helped even for once, ——. (c) —— before he fled away. (d) The UN should take proper steps to save Rohingyas ——. (e) But for his timely arrival ——.
guide_solution: Completing sentences (a) All of us have to work hard with a view to succeeding in life. (b) Could you avoid laughing aloud after reading the jokes? (c) Democratic Govt. will provide us with the rights to vote. (d) Since it was raining heavily, I could not go out. (e) Had I been a rich man, I would have taken Lionel Messi to his favourite restaurant.
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Mymensingh Zilla School, Mymensingh (Test Paper School 2nd) 2023
